correctness.rationale: Systematic identity columns give a bijection from q^k input messages to codewords. With s=Σ_i u_i mod q, the s=0 sector contributes A via the additive-character count of j nonzero residues with sum zero, [(q−1)^j+(q−1)(−1)^j]/q. For each s≠0, the pair (u_i,s−u_i) weighs 1 if u_i∈{0,s} and 2 otherwise; the root-of-unity filter gives a factor (2+(q−2)z)^k and (1−z)^k Σ_{a≠0} ζ^(−as)(1+ζ^{as})^k. Summing nonzero s uses exactly gcd(q,j−1)−1 nonzero solutions to (j−1)s=0, valid even for zero divisors, giving B. This is an exact partition for all integer q≥2, not a field-only argument. Independently directly enumerated generator codewords for 15 small (k,q) pairs and verified coefficients of the formula. A(1)=q^{k−1}, B(1)=(q−1)q^{k−1}, so all q^k words counted. Finite tests only corroborate the uniform character proof.
residual_risks: Ring Z/qZ, not a finite field for composite q; no field assumptions are used.

final_claim: For all k,q≥2 over the residue ring Z/qZ, the two integral spike generator matrices [I_k|J_k−I_k] and [I_k|J_k−I_k|1] have complete ordinary Hamming enumerators A_{k,q}(z)+z^k B_{k,q}(z) and A_{k,q}(z)+z^{k+1} B_{k,q}(z), where A and B use a single binomial-gcd statistic T=Σ_j C(k,j) gcd(q,j−1).
